summary: The approved revised Explore converges Change 2 into one new Formal Full Test execution/correction capability plus one bounded extension of the existing DeliveryOperationPackage. The plan reuses project-local ApplicableCheckDeclaration/checkRef identity and the existing Git-visible candidate identity, requires exact authorize-formal-full-test Owner authority, preserves Full Test check order, keeps flowkit-next's six gates repository-local, and freezes same-candidate external correction versus new-candidate repository correction without introducing a Registry, Planner, candidate invalidation subsystem, fake ActionPackage, or new lifecycle.
